⁧اللَّافِتَات⁩ The signs, the signs. Exercise 4. 1. Some users have posted a photo on social media that, in their opinion, would show a fire at the central market. 2. Going back to the original source, it turned out that the photo was taken five years ago. 3. We contacted the municipality, which confirmed that no fire occurred. 4. We did not find any evidence of the truthfulness of the claim. 5. Verdict: out of context.
a) out of context ( ⁧خارج السياق⁩ ): the photo is authentic but of another time.
b) misleading ( ⁧مضلل⁩ ): the phrase is true, but the cut overturns its sense.
c) true ( ⁧صحيح⁩ ): confirmed by primary sources.
d) fake ( ⁧مفبرك⁩ / ⁧زائف⁩ ), with the clarification that it is a possible artificially generated content
according to the technical evaluation of the platform ( ⁧التزييف العميق⁩ ).
e) misguided or missing context ( ⁧يحتاج إلى سياق⁩ ): the data is true but old.
f) non-verifiable ( ⁧لا يمكن التحقق منه⁩ / ⁧غير مؤكد⁩ ): no trace, no confirmation or denial.
⁧الصُّورَةُ حَقِيقِيَّةٌ، لٰكِنَّهَا التُقِطَتْ فِي بَلَدٍ آخَرَ.⁩

Exercise 9. a) Statement: A document with the Ministry logo announces the cancellation of the final exams of the high school. Research: official website and verified pages of the Ministry; comparison with previous official documents; search for similar texts; contact with the press office. Results: no announcements; official denial of the ministry; old logo, no number or date, language errors; similar text spread two years earlier in another country with another ministerial name; The press office shall define it as "falsified'. Verdict: False, because the document was built (it is not a real document removed from context). b) Fear (you look for any information and you believe what confirms your fears); empty (official sources delay and voices fill the void); trust (you believe the message because it comes from a close person). Solutions: rapid and clear communication of the institutions; Media education at school. The clarification: not all those who spread a voice are in bad faith; Many do so out of concern for their loved ones. Facts: few (the spread of messages in crises, presented as a common experience); interpretations: the three factors (attributed to researchers); the views attributed: solutions (some experts, others); author's opinion and final quote: the real concern is to stop before sharing. Exercise 10. 1. It turned out that the video released as if it showed protests yesterday actually dates back to a demonstration three years ago in another city. 2. Some social accounts have attributed to the rector statements he has never issued, as confirmed by the university press office. 3. We have not found any reliable source to confirm the correctness of the figures in the post. 4. The site usurps the name of a known press agency, changing only one letter into its web address. 5. Verdict: partially true; the decision was actually taken, but it does not affect all provinces, as the post says. Exercise 11. Personal answer. The tutor checks: title in the form of an application; complete structure; at least three test steps described with the correct vocabulary ( ⁧بِالرُّجُوعِ إِلَى⁩ · ⁧تَبَيَّنَ أَنَّ⁩ · ⁧تَوَاصَلْنَا مَعَ⁩ · ⁧لَمْ نَعْثُرْ عَلَى⁩ ); a verdict consistent with the results; invented case that does not concern real people. Exercise 12. a) "Urgent and very serious" with many exclamation points; (b) divide before they delete it; no source, date or link; the absolute ... all students. On official websites (interior, university, consulate) and in known newspapers. No confirmation, but an article two years earlier on a change in visa procedures of some countries. An old and partial news that turns into a catastrophe. b) Affirmative, facts, verdict. That the photo dates back to 2018 and it was taken in another country, with the reverse search of the image. Because the photo is authentic, not retouched: it is the context that is false. Authentic photo, but of another place and another year. c) To show the collapse of a bridge in the capital. That was filmed years ago in another continent and that the bridge did not suffer damage (communicato of the municipality). Out of context. Do not share what is not in a reliable source.

« ⁧أرسلها لكل أصدقائك⁩ (call for dissemination); no specific date. · 17–18. ⁧البَحْثُ فِي المَوَاقِعِ الرَّسْمِيَّةِ⁩ ( ⁧لِشَرِكَاتِ الاِتِّصَالَاتِ أَوِ الهَيْئَةِ المُخْتَصَّةِ⁩ ) · ⁧البَحْثُ عَنِ الخَبَرِ فِي مَصَادِرَ إِعْلَامِيَّةٍ مَوْثُوقَةٍ.⁩ · 19–20. Inverifiable / unconfirmed ( ⁧لا يمكن التحقق منه⁩ ): the absence of confirmation does not show that it is false, he just says that it was not possible to confirm it.
